    AI Overview
    As of April 2026, Rory McIlroy’s net worth is estimated to be between $255 million and $330 million, driven by massive career earnings, lucrative endorsements (Nike, TaylorMade), and investments. A 2025 Masters champion, he is one of the highest-paid athletes worldwide, boasting over $100 million in PGA Tour winnings. 
    Key Details on Rory McIlroy's Net Worth: 
    • Net Worth Range: Estimates commonly place his fortune over $200–$330 million, with some reports specifically stating $255M–$330M.
    • Career Earnings: Following his 2025 Masters win, McIlroy surpassed $100 million in official PGA Tour prize money, becoming only the second player in history (alongside Tiger Woods) to do so.
    • Endorsements: His major partnerships include a reported 10-year, $200 million Nike apparel extension (2017) and a 10-year deal with TaylorMade. Other partners include Omega, Bose, and UnitedHealth Group.
    • 2025 Earnings: He was ranked the #3 highest-paid golfer in 2025 by Forbes.
    • Business Ventures: He is a co-founder of TMRW Sports with Tiger Woods. 
    Major Income Sources 
    • PGA Tour/Tournament Wins: His victory at the 2025 Masters added $4.2 million to his earnings.
    • Endorsement Portfolio: Known for high-value deals with brands such as TaylorMade and Nike.
    • Investments: Active in business, including his role in TMRW Sports. 
    Reports suggest that in 2025, according to Golf365, McIlroy is considered one of the top 3 richest golfers in the world.

    AI Overview
    As of April 2026, Rory McIlroy's net worth is estimated to be between $250 million and $330 million. His wealth is driven by a highly successful PGA Tour career—earning over $100 million in prize money—and lucrative endorsement deals with brands like Nike, TaylorMade, and Omega, plus his investment firm, Symphony Ventures. 
    Key Drivers of Net Worth 
    • Career Earnings: McIlroy is among the top earners in PGA Tour history, with over $100 million in prize money.
    • Endorsements: His long-term deals include a reported $100 million-plus contract with Nike and a $100 million deal with TaylorMade.
    • Business & Investments:
      Co-founded TMRW Sports with Tiger Woods and runs Symphony Ventures, investing in companies like TickPick and Whoop.
       
    McIlroy's consistent performance, coupled with his position as a primary face of golf, has enabled him to turn down massive offers to join the LIV Golf league.
